## Merge checklist / 合入检查

- [ ] Target is `dev` from `feat/*`, or `main` from this repository's `dev`.
- [ ] Build and test, Dependency review, CodeQL (Swift), CodeQL (Actions), and Branch flow pass.
- [ ] Security findings and review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] No credentials, generated release artifacts, or local IDE settings are included.

See [the contribution workflow](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
